name: SOGS (Second-Order Anchor for Advanced 3D Gaussian Splatting)
definition: An anchor-based 3D-GS technique that introduces second-order anchors to achieve superior rendering quality and reduced anchor features and model size simultaneously.
summary: SOGS is an anchor-based 3D Gaussian Splatting technique that uses second-order statistics to model feature covariance, enabling high-fidelity rendering with smaller model sizes.
